plan.cache_policy: Eight fixed augmented training minibatches are reused cyclically; feedback images use original deterministic center crops.
plan.start_policy: Same final entropy weights, seed62001 anchors and fresh SGD state in every condition. Warmup is discarded; weights, optimizer, RNG and controller are reset before measurement.
plan.precision: Original bf16 forward autocast, fp32 parameters and geometry; fp32 feedback inference; frozen BatchNorm running statistics.
plan.optimizer_policy: Fresh original SGD parameter groups/momentum/Nesterov/decay; constant learning rate 0.025. No cosine schedule is extrapolated from this short timing diagnostic.
plan.measured_boundary: Synchronized training, CPU-to-GPU transfer and controller monitoring including initial/100/200-step holdout CE; excludes cache creation, checkpoint loading/saving, acquisition and evaluation export.
plan.lite_ce_policy: Faithful original Control path retained, including holdout CE even though Lite coefficient formula does not depend on CE.
plan.streamlined_fixed: Exact geometry objective, without unused total/kappa statistics, record conversion, EMA or holdout evaluation.
plan.research_instrumented: Full original geometry scalar monitoring, EMA, in-memory scalar trace and batch-chain hashing, plus holdout CE for every treatment; no checkpoint or CSV disk writes.
plan.limitation: Short cached-batch timings on one backbone/checkpoint/hardware setup. They cannot be extrapolated into full-job speed, accuracy or tuning efficiency.

summary.hypothesis_tests: None: repeated timings on one checkpoint are descriptive

tuning_cost.lite_development_search_cost: Unknown; frozen settings are not evidence of zero prior development cost
tuning_cost.engineering_effort: Not measured by runtime; includes implementation, state handling, testing and maintenance
